m: 1. अशन mfn. reaching, reaching across, Nir.
2. अशन n. eating, ŚBr. &c.
food, ŚBr. &c. (often ifc., e.g. मूल-फलाशन mf(आ)n. having roots and fruit for food, Mn. &c.)

a: अशन — a. [अश्-ल्युट्] Reaching, reaching across. --नः N. of a tree = असन q. v. --नं 1 Pervasion, penetration. --2 The act of eating, feeding. --3 Tasting, enjoying. --4 Food; अशनं धात्रा मरुत्कल्पितं व्यालानां Bh. 3. 10; मांसाशनं च नाश्नीयुः Ms. 5. 73; यज्ञशिष्ट˚ 3. 118; फलमूलाशनैः 5. 54; oft. at the end of adjective comp. in the sense of ‘eating’, ‘one whose food is’ &c.; फलमूलाशन, हुताशन, पवनाशन &c. --Comp. --कृत् a. Ved. preparing food. --पतिः lord of food. --पर्णी a kind of tree.

अशन—क्रिया f. the taking of food (˚यां-कृ, ‘to eat’), Pañcat.

। api vfndArakAyUyaM na jAnIta SarIriRAm । saMsTAyAM yastvaBidroho duHsahaScetanApahaH । jijIvizURAM jIvAnAmAtmA prezWEhepsitaH । kOtsaheta taM dAtuM BikzamARAya jizRave” iti daDIcokte devEH punaruktam yaTA “kiM nu taddustyajaM brahman! puMsAM BUtAnu kampinAm । BavadviDAnAM mahatAM puRyaSlokEkakarmaRAm । nUnaM svArTaparoloko na veda parasaNkawam । yadi veda na yAceta neti nAha yadISvaraH । ityukte daDIcoktam “DarmaM vaHSrotukAmena yUyaMme pratyudAhftAH । eza vaH priyamAtmAnaM dustyajaM santyajAmyaham । yo'DruveRAtmanA nATA! अशनि (अयस्), m. pl. N. of a warrior tribe, (g. पर्श्व्-आदि, q.v.)
a: अशनिः — m. f. [अश्नुते संहति, अश् अनि Uṇ. 2. 101] 1 Indra's thunderbolt; शक्रस्य महाशनिध्वजं R. 3. 56. --2 Flash of lightning; अनुवनमशनिर्गतः Sk.; अशनिः कल्पित एष वेधसा R. 8. 47; अशनेरमृतस्य चोभयोर्वशिनश्चांबुधराश्च योनयः Ku. 4. 43. --3 A missile. --4 The tip of a missile. --5 A sacrificial rite (अनुयाज) to kill an enemy. --6 A master. --निः m. 1 Indra. --2 Fire. --3 Fire produced from lightning.

k.v: ह्रादिनी वज्रमस्त्री स्यात्कुलिशं भिदुरं पविः। शतकोटिः स्वरुः शम्बो दम्भोलिरशनिर्द्वयोः॥

m: अशनि—ग्रावन् m. a diamond, Prab.
अशनि—हत mfn. struck by lightning, Kāṭh.
अशनिक mfn. = अशनौ कुशल, (g. आकर्षादि, q.v.)
अशनि—मत् (अशनि-), mfn. possessing the thunderbolt, RV. iv, 17, 13.
अशनिन् mfn. = अशनि-मत्, q.v., MBh. xiii, 1157.
अशनि—प्रभ m. N. of a Rākṣasa, R. vi, 69, 11
अ-शपत् mfn. not cursing, AV. vi, 37, 3 and vii, 59, 1.

m: अ-शरीर mf(आ)n. bodiless, incorporeal, AitBr.; ŚBr. xiv, &c.
not coming from a visible body (as a voice), R. iv, 63, 6; Kathās.
अ-शरीर m. N. of Kāma, Śiś. ix, 61
अ-शरीर n. (in rhetoric) absence of the verb in a sentence.
a: अशरीर — a. Bodiless, incorporeal. --रः 1 The Supreme Being (परमात्मन्), Brahma. --2 (In Mīmāmsā) A god or deity in general. --3 Cupid, the god of love चेतांसि चिंताभिरिवाशरीरः Ki. 17. 10: Śi. 9. 61. --4 An ascetic who has renounced all worldly connections; ˚त्वं --ता absolution.

v: aSarIratva

na॰ aSarIrasya BAvaH tva । 1 SarIrasambanDarAhitye 2 mokze ca । yaTA mokzasyASarIratvaM taToktaM SA॰ BA॰ । “aSarIraM vAva santaM priyApriye na spfSataH” iti priyApriya sparSanapratizeDAccodanAlakzaRaDarmmakAryyatvaM mokzAKyasyASarIratvasya pratiziDyata iti gamyate । DarmakAryyatve hi priyApriyasparSanapratizeDonopapadyate । aSarIratvameva GarmakAryyamiti cet tasya svABAvikatvAt । “aSarIraM SarIrezu anavavasTezvavasTitam । mahAntaM viBumAtmAnaM matvA DIro na Socati” “aprARohyamanAH SuBraH asaNgohyazaM puruza” ityAdi SrutiByaH । ataevAnuzWeyaPala vilakzaRaM mokzAKyamaSarIratvaM nityamiti sidDam” । ayaM BAvaH aBAvasyADikaraRAnatirekeRa SarIrasambanDABAvasya brahmarUpatayA mokzasya tadaBinnatayA ca taTAtvam iti ।
aSarIrin
tri॰ na SarIrI । 1 dehaSUnye brahmaRi 2 mImAMsakokte devamAtre ca । SarIramuccArayitftvenAstyasya ini na॰ ta॰ । 3 SarIreRAnucAryye AkASaSabde । uBayatra striyAM NIp । “vAguvAcASarIriRI” BA॰ A॰ pa॰ ।
m: अ-शरीरिन् mfn. incorporeal, RāmatUp.
not coming from a visible body (as a voice), R.; Uttarar. &c.
a: अशरीरिन् — a. Incorporeal, unearthly, heavenly; usually with words like वाणी, वाक् &c. U. 2, Ve. 3, Ś, {4} 1 Brahmā. --2 A god.

m: अशरणी-कृत mfn. deprived of refuge, VarBṛS.
(Pañcat.)
अ-शरण mf(आ)n. destitute of refuge, defenceless, R.; Megh.; Śak. &c.
a: अशरण — a. Helpless, forlorn, destitute of refuge; बलवदशरणोस्मि Ś. 6; so अशरण्य.

m: अ-शरण्य mfn. not yielding refuge, MBh.; R.
destitute of refuge, wanting refuge, R. iii, 55, 65; Daś.
अ-शरमय mfn. not made of reeds, MaitrS.
अ-शरव्य mf(आ)n. not to be reached by arrows, ŚBr. v.
अ-शर्मन् n. unhappiness, Kir.
a: अशर्मन् — a. Unhappy, afflicted, sorry. --n. Unhappiness, misery, affliction, sorrow; एकौघभूतं तदशर्म कृष्णां (प्रपेदे) Ki. 3. 35; 12. 25.

s: aSarmma

[n,] klI, (na Sarmma । naYsamAsaH । nAsti Sarmma yasmin iti samAse vAcyaliNgaH .) kazwaM । duHKaM । (“ekOGaBUtaM tadaSarmma kfzRAM viBAvarIM DvAntamiva prapede ॥” iti BAraviH ॥) tadviSizwe tri । iti jawADaraH ॥

v: aSarmman
na॰ viroDe na॰ ta॰ । 1 SarmmaBinne duHKe na॰ ba॰ । 2 suKa SUnye tri॰ ।

m: अ-शस् mfn. (√ शंस्), not blessing or wishing well, cursing, hating, RV. ii, 34, 9 and iv, 4, 15.
a: अशस् — a. Ved. 1 Not blessing, not praising. --2 Cursing, hating.

m: अ-शस्त mfn. ‘ineffable’ or ‘unwished’, AV. vi, 45, 1.
a: अशस्त — a. Ved. 1 Inexpressible, untold. --2 Not esteemed, hated, ill-starred. --Comp. --वार a. Ved, who is not asked for wealth, i. e. who grants it of his own accord; Rv. 10. 99. 5; having indescribable treasures(?)

m: अ-शस्त—वार (अशस्त-), mfn. having indescribable treasures, RV. x, 99, 5 [‘who is not asked for wealth i.e. who grants it of his own accord’, Sāy.]
अ-शस्ति f. not wishing well, curse, RV. vi, 68, 6
(generally personified) a curser, hater, RV.; AV.; VS.
a: अशस्तिः — f. Ved. 1 Not wishing well, an evil wish or design, curse, imprecation. --2 A curser, hater.

m: अ-शस्ति—हन् mfn. averting curses or cursers, RV.
1. अ-शस्त्र mf(आ)n. having no invocation, MārkP.
2. अ-शस्त्र mfn. (√ 1. शस्), weaponless, unarmed, MBh. &c.
a: अशस्त्र — a. Having no weaponsunarmed. --स्त्रं Not a weapon; ˚विहितो वधः H. 2. 85; ˚पूतं मरणमुपदिशामि Ve. 2 (आत्मघातित्वेन शस्त्रेण न पूतं); अशस्त्रपूतं Māl. 5. 12.

m: अ-शस्त्र—पाणि mfn. not having a sword in one's hand, Veṇīs.
अ-शत n. not a full hundred, ŚBr. iv.
अ-शत—दक्षिण (अ-शत-) mfn. where the Dakṣiṇā is less than a hundred, ib.

s: aSatruH
puM, (na + Sad + krun । naYtatpuruzaH .) candraH । iti SabdacandrikA ॥ Satrurahite mitre ca tri ॥
v: aSatru
pu॰ na SAtayati Sada--RyarTe trun na॰ ta॰ । 1 candre Sabdaca॰ । viroDe na॰ ta॰ । SatruBinne 2 mitre ca ।
m: अ-शत्रु mfn. one who has no adversary or whom no enemy defies (especially said of Indra), RV.
without opposition from enemies, RV. v, 2, 12
अ-शत्रु (उस्), m. the moon, L.
अ-शत्रु (उ), n. condition of having no enemy, AV. vi, 40, 2.
a: अशत्रु — a. 1 One who has no enemy. --2 One whom no enemy defies or challenges. --3 Without opposition from foes. --त्रु n. The condition of having no enemies. --त्रुः The moon.

m: अ-शवाग्नि m. ‘not a corpse-fire’ or fire kindled to burn a corpse, ŚBr. xii.
अ-शय्य m. ‘having no bed’, a partic. class of ascetics, R.
